_comment: PWNAGE-31000 pre-lockscreen cinema. The controller (/usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-preload-cinema) plays this asset as a fullscreen, audio-free Wayland client over the real Nuxel lockscreen, then releases it only after video EOF and lockscreen readiness. Every failure path falls back to the existing lockscreen. max_display_ms bounds the moving-video interval; hard_timeout_ms bounds the final-frame hold if readiness is still pending. early_map_delay_ms lets WebKit finish its map/fullscreen commits after launcher_ready before mpv maps, so mpv is the top toplevel; covered is published only after nuxel-wl-fb is actually scanning. audio=never is deliberate: the supplied clip contains an AAC track, but Nuxel has no verified boot-audio output route and mute is the safe policy, so the controller always passes --no-audio --mute=yes.

_asset.video: H.264 High, 1080x1920, 24 fps, 144 frames, yuv420p, bt709/tv
_asset.audio: AAC-LC, 48000 Hz, stereo; deliberately not played
_asset.decode: software decode via mpv/FFmpeg-free; verified with ffmpeg -f null on the build host

_readiness.display: FRAMES_OK/owner=nuxel-wl-fb in /run/nuxel-wl-fb.state, with a fresh DISPLAY_ON + owner=nuxel-wl-fb in /var/lib/nuxel/display (stale receipts ignored)
_readiness.touch: an ARMED_OK status receipt (later TOUCH_POINT event lines are ignored), or an honest NO_TOUCH_DEVICE/SCAN_FAIL warning in /run/nuxel-touch-arm.state
